source_fields.formulation: Minimize expected counterfactual regret for an unknown linear system against bounded finite-memory disturbance-response controllers.

assumptions.description: The deterministic instance $(A_t,B_t,w_t,c_t)_{t=1}^T$ is fixed before the controller seed. The state obeys $x_{t+1}=A_tx_t+B_tu_t+w_t$, $x_1=0$, with $x_t\in\mathbb R^{d_x}$ and unrestricted $u_t\in\mathbb R^{d_u}$. The natural trajectory has zero input: $x_1^{\mathrm{nat}}=0$, $x_{t+1}^{\mathrm{nat}}=A_tx_t^{\mathrm{nat}}+w_t$.
assumptions.scope: The domain stated in this clause.

assumptions.description: Let $G_t^{[i]}=A_t\cdots A_{t-i+1}B_{t-i}$ for $0\le i<t$, with $G_t^{[0]}=B_t$ and zero padding for $i\ge t$. The public regularity budgets satisfy $\|x_t^{\mathrm{nat}}\|\le R_{\mathrm{nat}}$ and $\sum_{i\ge\ell}\|G_t^{[i]}\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le R_G\rho^\ell$ for every $\ell\ge0$, where $0<\rho<1$.
assumptions.scope: The domain stated in this clause.

assumptions.description: Each cost is convex and nonnegative on the full state–input space, obeys $c_t(x,u)\le L\max\{1,\|x\|^2+\|u\|^2\}$, and every subgradient obeys $\|g\|\le L\max\{1,\|x\|+\|u\|\}$. Nonsmooth costs and quadratic growth are allowed.
assumptions.scope: The domain stated in this clause.

assumptions.description: The instancewise variation budget is $V_{[T]}=T^{-1}\inf_G\sum_{t=1}^T\|G-G_t\|_{\ell_2,F}^2\le v$, with $\|G\|_{\ell_2,F}^2=\sum_{i\ge0}\|G^{[i]}\|_F^2$. This is squared deviation from a constant Markov operator, not successive-difference variation.
assumptions.scope: The domain stated in this clause.

source_fields.operation: Observe the full state x_t, choose u_t, incur c_t(x_t,u_t), and then observe the next state and the entire current cost function. The actual dynamics and disturbances are hidden. Public information consists of the horizon, dimensions, regularity and comparator budgets. Internal computation and input magnitudes are unrestricted. The model does not supply a strong-controllability promise or a known stabilizing state-feedback matrix.

source_fields.feasibility: The output is the actual causal control trajectory. Each comparator must be evaluated on its own counterfactual trajectory under the same matrices and disturbances.

source_fields.base_expression: The comparator parameters satisfy $\mathcal M_m(R_M)=\{(M^{[0]},\ldots,M^{[m-1]}):\sum_{i=0}^{m-1}\|M^{[i]}\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le R_M\}$ and use $u_t^M=\sum_{i=0}^{m-1}M^{[i]}x_{t-i}^{\mathrm{nat}}$, with prehistory zero. Regret is $\operatorname{Reg}_T(A;I)=\mathbb E_A\sum_t c_t(x_t,u_t)-\inf_{M\in\mathcal M_m(R_M)}\sum_t c_t(x_t^M,u_t^M)$.

source_fields.budget: The fixed horizon T counts control transitions and full state/cost feedback. Every probing and identification input incurs its actual cost. There is no uncharged system-identification phase and no input-norm restriction.
